requirements.title: Trick S_define Integration
requirements.description: The sim harness shall integrate sim_dynamics, sim_sensors, sim_scenario, and FSW POSIX into a single Trick simulation.
requirements.rationale: PM-required Trick top-level integration providing a single closed-loop SITL simulation for FT1 nav anchoring.

requirements.title: Time-Stepped Sim Orchestration
requirements.description: The sim harness shall advance the simulation on a fixed time step driven by the Trick scheduler.
requirements.rationale: PM-required deterministic time-stepped orchestration so dynamics, sensors, and FSW execute in a repeatable order.

requirements.title: Sensor-to-FSW Boundary
requirements.description: The sim harness shall deliver simulated sensor measurements to the FSW POSIX driver inputs each step.
requirements.rationale: PM-required boundary between Trick-side sensor models and the FSW POSIX driver layer for each scheduled step.

requirements.title: POSIX FSW Execution Inside Sim
requirements.description: The sim harness shall execute the FSW POSIX applications and libraries in-process during each simulation step.
requirements.rationale: PM-required so Trick exercises the same FSW software paths used on flight hardware via the POSIX build.

requirements.title: Scenario Configuration Selection
requirements.description: The sim harness shall select the scenario configuration via Trick command-line arguments at run start.
requirements.rationale: PM-required command-line scenario selection to enable batch runs and operator-driven configuration.

requirements.title: Reproducible Run Output
requirements.description: The sim harness shall produce identical run outputs given identical scenario configuration and random seed inputs.
requirements.rationale: PM-required reproducibility for regression analysis and FT1 nav anchoring across repeated Trick runs.

requirements.title: SD Log Artifact Emission
requirements.description: The sim harness shall emit the FSW SD card log as a file artifact each run.
requirements.rationale: PM-required SD log artifact captured during sim runs for post-run analysis and FT1 anchoring.

requirements.title: Telemetry Capture Artifact
requirements.description: The sim harness shall capture FSW telemetry packets to a file artifact each run.
requirements.rationale: PM-required telemetry transcript artifact captured during sim runs for ground-station behavioral verification.

requirements.title: Truth-vs-FSW Comparison Artifact
requirements.description: The sim harness shall write a truth-versus-FSW comparison file containing simulated truth and FSW nav state.
requirements.rationale: PM-required comparison artifact enabling nav-vs-truth post-run analysis for FT1 sim closure.

requirements.title: Run Artifact Output Directory
requirements.description: The sim harness shall collect all run output artifacts under a single configurable output directory.
requirements.rationale: PM-required collection of all sim artifacts in one known location for downstream tooling and archival.
